canvas.note: Keep existing shared Canvas scaler. Convert these reference coordinates if the host uses another scale.

spriteBorders.proofBorderScale: Use each ComponentManifest entry when present; otherwise .6
spriteBorders.exceptions: Badge grid uses .35. Never stretch a whole nine-slice sprite. Badges/emblems use Simple and PreserveAspect.

safeLayout.title: top safe-area + 80 reference units
safeLayout.navigation: bottom safe-area, height 220, never covered by list
safeLayout.form: ScrollRect; scroll focused input above keyboard
safeLayout.teamDetails: summary and member list scroll together on short screens; close remains in safe header
safeLayout.badgePicker: center; max width 796; title, close, footer fixed; grid scrolls when height is insufficient

modal.selection: outline plus checkmark; color alone is insufficient

viewportAcceptance.check: scrolling, 48 dp targets, no clipped footer
if landscape is enabled, capped modal and scroll body; otherwise retain app portrait lock

validationStatus: Static 1080x1920 screens plus 1440x2560 and 2160x3840 detail compositions reviewed. Native responsive layout, keyboard and safe-area behavior are acceptance requirements, not tested runtime behavior.
